dialogues.speaker: Frostmoon Scions' Bulletin
dialogues.text: "When you stand alone, wrapped in layers of darkness and cold... When even your words freeze in your throat... Call upon the name of Lady Kuutar."

dialogues.speaker: Frostmoon Scions' Bulletin
dialogues.text: "If you feel lost in the mortal world beneath the moonlight, the Frostmoon Scions will join you in waiting for the gentle glow of the moon. May it illuminate your road ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And when the moon shines not, you can always trust in your kuuvahki devices!"
